description:
A source `%Struct{}` pattern currently loses its schema discriminator and misprojects its field subpatterns.

## Reproducer

```fz
defmodule Box do
  defstruct [:value]
end

fn classify(v) do
  case v do
    %Box{value: x} -> {:box, x}
    _ -> :other
  end
end

fn main() do
  dbg(classify(%Box{value: 7}))
  dbg(classify(%{1 => :one}))
end
```

The first result must be `{:box, 7}`; the plain map must select the fallback and return `:other`. Today the dispatch plan can treat the struct row as irrefutable, then the selected body faults at `assert_struct`.

## Cause

`src/dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs` handles `Pattern::Struct` without emitting a named-struct question. It also applies each field subpattern to the original struct subject instead of a projection of that named field.

The tagged-record type algebra delivered by `fz-tfn.1` already owns struct-vs-plain-map type carving and mixed protocol receiver unions. This ticket must use that typed identity and must not recreate a parallel nominal/string mechanism.

A second erasure is part of the same correctness boundary: `Types::runtime_envelope`, used for semantic dispatch reachability, currently shares the map transform that intentionally reduces `runtime_type_test_envelope` to runtime-observable struct tags. Both clear positive named-struct fields. Once the plan has exact `StructField` subjects, semantic projection still cannot recover a known field type from that tag-only envelope. The two APIs answer different questions and must not share a falsely narrow reading.

## Correct model

One World-backed pattern resolver supplies the interned tagged-record `Ty` for a source struct target at every production plan boundary: function entry, guard helper, local `case`/`with`/`receive`, and source diagnostics. The plan emits that typed discriminator first. Its success evidence alone owns exact named `StructField` projections, so no field can be read on the miss edge. Tuple storage layout is not struct semantic identity, and canonical/display strings are never keys or comparands.

The existing runtime envelope mode must state its full purpose. Semantic reachability retains and recursively envelopes positive named-struct fields so plan-owned field subjects project exact types. Runtime predicate construction keeps its current tag-only reading because the predicate observes schema identity, not field contents. Preserve callable construction identity, safe negative-polarity widening, and the distinction between semantic projection evidence and runtime-test observability without adding a parallel envelope or struct-only side flag.

Source diagnostics already run with `World`, the exact function namespace, and source owner. They use the same resolver and interned module identity; do not add an unresolved-name map, source pre-scan, warning-only matcher, or compatibility fallback. Struct-definition/schema obligations remain owned by the existing lowerer boundary.

## Required checks

- The reproducer prints `{:box, 7}` then `:other` through interp, run, and AOT.
- A source-plan or backend assertion proves `%Box{...}` emits a typed named-struct discriminator.
- Success-edge evidence owns each named field projection; the miss edge owns none.
- Field subpatterns are applied to their named field projections, including a non-variable field pattern that distinguishes two Box values.
- A same-shaped plain map and a different same-layout named struct do not enter the struct body.
- Nested/qualified struct names remain exact and do not use canonical Ty display strings as semantic keys.
- Static reachability over a known tagged record preserves field precision and prunes a literal-field arm that cannot win; `runtime_type_test_envelope` remains tag-only.
- Guard-helper and selective-receive struct patterns consume the same discriminator/projection model.
- Existing `enumerable_protocol_dispatch` and `membership_operator` fixtures remain green on all three lanes.
- Full library and serial fixture matrix pass with formatting, check, strict Clippy, deterministic artifacts/work signals, documentation, and no migration debris.
title: Source struct patterns omit their discriminator and misproject fields
